# DMDroid

DMDroid is cold DM outreach automation for SMMA owners, coaches, and agencies.
You import target lists, build multi-step message sequences with A/B testing, and
DMDroid sends personalized DMs from your connected Instagram accounts automatically.
It runs in your own browser session on your machine (keep your PC on while campaigns
run), on your own VPS for 24/7, or fully hosted with Done-For-You. Rate caps,
sending windows, and health monitoring built in.
Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial (card required, cancel before day 3 to
avoid being charged). Contact: support@dmdroid.app

## Plans

- Solo Operator: $69/mo: 1 Instagram account, unlimited personalized DMs, full
  sequence builder, A/B testing, visual pipeline + analytics, email support.
- Agency: from $106/mo: 2-30 connected accounts, volume discount per account,
  everything in Solo Operator, per-account health monitoring, priority support.
- Done-For-You: custom: managed RDP + proxy infrastructure, full campaign setup
  and management, dedicated success manager, white-glove onboarding.

Start: https://app.dmdroid.app/auth

## FAQ

- What is DMDroid? An Instagram DM outreach tool: import target lists, build
  multi-step sequences with A/B testing, the droid sends personalized DMs
  automatically from your connected accounts. Runs on your machine, your VPS,
  or fully hosted with Done-For-You.
- How does it work? Import targets (list, CSV, Excel), build opener + follow-ups
  with at least 5 variants per step, hit launch. Replies stop the sequence and land
  in your pipeline: DM'd > Initiated > Engaged > Calendly > Booked.
- Will my account get banned? Every account runs in its own isolated browser
  session with daily rate caps and heartbeat monitoring for anomalies.
- Do I need to keep my computer on? Yes, unless you run it on a VPS or use
  Done-For-You (we host and run everything, you just reply).
- Do I need my own Instagram accounts? Yes, you bring the accounts.
- Multiple accounts? Up to 30 on Agency, fully isolated sessions.
- Free trial? 3 days free, card required upfront.
- Cost? Solo $69/mo, Agency from $106/mo, Done-For-You custom.
